resources.string: Point the camera at the barcode or QR code on your card
Cardholder needs the camera to scan the code on your card. Images are analysed on the device and never stored or sent anywhere.
Camera access is turned off for Cardholder. Turn it on in the app\'s settings to scan codes.
The camera couldn\'t be started. Close other apps that use it and try again.
Hold your card flat against the back of your phone and keep it still.
Couldn\'t read the card. Move it slowly around the back of the phone and try again.
The CVV is not stored on the chip; please type it in yourself.
